_comment: Mapping from canonical GitHub login → identity. 'aliases' captures alternate identities (Cologne SSH dialog hosts, mistyped emails, hostname-based commits) that should be merged into the canonical record. 'is_bot' = true excludes the entry from human contributor reports. 'consent' = the contributor's consent to public display of their name/ORCID in observatory reports and the dashboard: 'yes' / 'no' / '' (empty = not yet recorded; only 'yes' counts as consented — filling real values is the maintainer-gated C1/A3 step, roadmap docs/OBSERVATORY_ROADMAP.md).
